# Vendored: Azgaar's Fantasy Map Generator

`afmg/` is the `src/` folder of [Azgaar's Fantasy Map Generator](https://github.com/Azgaar/Fantasy-Map-Generator)
at commit `2d95440222b2dc8504eddeeba7f7a064f398563c` (Nov 27, 2026, version 1.159.0), copied as it is on
Nov 27, 2026, with AFMG's `LICENSE` (MIT) beside it.

Nothing under `afmg/` is edited. AFMG's interface folders (`assets`, `controllers`, `renderers`, `ui`, `app`)
are kept because the generator imports from `ui/`; the bundler leaves out what the generator does not use.
The pin is not updated in phase 7A; pruning the copy comes later, under the same tests
(`packages/worldgen/test`).
